summary: E-commerce admin panel with shop management system, allowing manual open/close control and customer-facing status indicators
architectural_notes: Shop status managed as global state synchronized across admin and customer views
Real-time status updates needed to handle mid-checkout closures

existing_features.title: Add a shop status toggle switch at the top of the Admin Dashboard that allows admins to manually open or close the shop

Display a full-width notice banner on the home screen when the shop is closed with the text 'Namaste! MBG Store is currently Closed. We are not accepting orders right now. We will open again at 8:00 AM. Thank you for your patience!' using a calm background color (soft orange or grey)
Disable 'Add to Cart' and 'Checkout' buttons across the entire app when the shop is closed
Add a small colored dot indicator next to the store name in the header showing green when open and red when closed
Show a popup notification during checkout with the message 'Sorry, the store just closed. Please place your order when we reopen!' if the shop closes while a customer has items in their cart

new_feature_requests.summary: Admin shop status toggle switch on dashboard
Shop closed banner on home screen with disabled cart/checkout
Open/closed indicator dot next to store name in header
Popup notification when shop closes during checkout
Store shop open/closed status in the backend and provide methods to get and update the status
Prevent customers from placing new orders when the shop is closed
